Which shipments had a cold-chain excursi:
ReeferTelemetry
| where ts >= datetime(2026-07-01) and ts < datetime(2026-08-01)
| summarize readings_above_5c = countif(temp_c > 5.0), max_temp_c = max(temp_c), first_ts = min(ts), last_ts = max(ts) by shipment_id, truck_id
| extend time_out_of_range_minutes = readings_above_5c * 15
| where time_out_of_range_minutes >= 30
| order by time_out_of_range_minutes desc
Show the temperature trace for shipment:
ReeferTelemetry
| where shipment_id == "SH000500"
| project ts, truck_id, temp_c, setpoint_c, door_open, reefer_status
| order by ts asc
What was the hourly average and maximum:
ReeferTelemetry
| where facility_id == "P04" and ts >= datetime(2026-08-12) and ts < datetime(2026-08-13)
| summarize avg_temp_c = round(avg(temp_c), 2), max_temp_c = max(temp_c) by truck_id, bin(ts, 1h)
| order by truck_id asc, ts asc
How many door-open events were recorded:
ReeferTelemetry
| where door_open == true
| summarize door_open_events = count(), shipments = dcount(shipment_id) by facility_id
| order by door_open_events desc
Where is truck TRK-113 right now and is:
ReeferTelemetry
| where truck_id == "TRK-113"
| summarize arg_max(ts, *) by truck_id
| project truck_id, ts, latitude, longitude, speed_kmh, ignition_on, temp_c, setpoint_c, reefer_status, shipment_id
Which trucks are carrying a warm load wh:
ReeferTelemetry
| summarize arg_max(ts, *) by truck_id
| where temp_c > 5.0 and speed_kmh > 0
| project truck_id, shipment_id, ts, temp_c, speed_kmh, latitude, longitude
How many shipments waited more than 2 ho:
ReeferTelemetry
| where ts >= datetime(2026-07-01) and ts < datetime(2026-08-01)
| summarize first_ts = min(ts), departed_ts = minif(ts, speed_kmh > 0) by shipment_id, facility_id
| extend dock_wait_h = (departed_ts - first_ts) / 1h
| summarize shipments = count(), waited_over_2h = countif(dock_wait_h > 2), avg_dock_wait_h = round(avg(dock_wait_h), 2) by facility_id
| order by waited_over_2h desc
